title: Villager Debug Names
description: Shows a villager's debug name without having to enable debug flags.
body:
# Villager Names

A Minecraft Fabric mod that shows a villager's debug name without having to enable debug flags.

## Features

Press `V` while looking at a villager to see their debug name.
![2026-01-05_19.36.30.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dffbd390051150af8f58a7da6720446d7472185_0.webp)

Enter a villager's trading menu to see their debug name.
![2026-01-05_19.36.42.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ee70762afb6e91d4e35330c89daaa24afb96a47_0.webp)

Note: This mod has to be installed on both the client and server to work properly.
